questions: Should the function raise an exception if the Excel file exists but contains no data (empty DataFrame) after reading the specified sheet, or should it return an empty dictionary?
If a column contains only non-numeric values (e.g., strings), should that column be omitted from the output dictionary entirely, or included with a sum of 0 (or NaN)?
Should the CSV file be written even if the Excel file contains no numeric columns (or is empty), or should writing be skipped in some error cases?
What should happen if the Excel file contains multiple sheets with the same name? Should the first match be used, or should it raise an error?
Should the function handle Excel files with hidden or very hidden sheets? Should it attempt to read them if the sheet_name matches?
If the path to the CSV file location includes directories that do not exist, should the function create them or raise an error?
Should the function validate that the Excel file is actually an Excel file (e.g., by extension or content) before attempting to read, or rely on pandas to raise appropriate errors?
What encoding should be used when writing the CSV file? Should it be UTF-8, system default, or something else?
